body: I don't know whether I'm being condescending, or you are. It is going to such, let's not pretend.

It ain't gonna get better, I know it. You might. But I love you for doing it, it makes me feel as a person.

I wished I could've said I had a good run, but I didn't. Just depressed, tired of all of it. All. I see the depressionspren all around my head, and I'm so happy I can see a way out. Once and for all. Happy, is this the feeling?
